title: Wesley Snipes: Three Years in Prison Over Unfiled Tax Returns
description:
In April 2008 a federal judge sentenced Wesley Snipes to three years' imprisonment for failing to file income tax returns. A jury found him guilty on those charges in February and acquitted him of five others, including felony tax fraud. The government's $13.8 million figure was an allegation, not a verdict.
